frontmatter.title: The Sui Blockchain and Move: A Brutally Honest Look for the Rest of Us
frontmatter.subheading: Forget the technical jargon. Is Sui really the 'blockchain for the next billion users', or just another complex project for tech elites? We break it down.
frontmatter.excerpt: A brutally honest, non-technical guide to the Sui blockchain and the Move programming language. We explain what it is, why it's different, and if it really matters for the average person.
frontmatter.author: Paul Serban
